cohort: 15,615 neonates born in 2015 at a maternity hospital in Xiamen, China, and their mothers
finding: The incidence of congenital hypothyroidism (CH) in neonates was associated with gestational age and birth weight, and neonatal baseline CH positivity was positively associated with cesarean delivery and an early-pregnancy maternal TSH level >2.5 mIU/L.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered vaginally had significantly lower TSH levels and a reduced incidence of baseline CH positivity; cesarean section delivery was a risk factor for CH positivity at baseline (OR = 2.06, p = 0.006).
